judged_text: [High/bug] Office 365 collective-host events always use the first destination calendar instead of the calendar associated with each host credential.

record.issue_text: [High/bug] Office 365 collective-host events always use the first destination calendar instead of the calendar associated with each host credential.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the Office365CalendarService in the diff (packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts), the createEvent method extracts `[mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []` and uses only this first calendar for the eventsUrl. Unlike GoogleCalendarService which was updated to accept a credentialId parameter and find the matching destination calendar (`event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`), Office365CalendarService's createEvent signature wasn't updated to include credentialId. This means for collective team events where multiple hosts have different destination calendars, Office365 will always use the first destination calendar rather than the one matching each host's credential.
